A.finding: The sampled output code ID and probability are disclosed while the private input bin is withheld. For a fixed bank, fitted mean NLL/Brier are affine in Q. Binary SEX Bayes-accuracy epigraphs are LP-representable with one local channel fixed; the joint product-channel problem is nonconvex and alternating LP is only a coordinate heuristic. Class-only decisions give an ideal-reader leakage floor but are not presumed confidence-eligible.
A.claim_limit: No finite-law objective proves fresh attack AUC, stochastic advantage, joint advantage, or feature-sharing protection.

B.finding: End-to-end Gaussian bottlenecks and sampled-code task heads alter acquisition. Teacher scores are fitting targets only. The average variational KL is a modeled input-rate bound under conditional-independent sampling; it is not a SEX-AUC or deterministic-mean-release bound. Complete sampled feature views and matched task-only, deterministic, local, sequential and raw-joint arms are specified.
B.open_gate: Numeric training settings, durable one-draw deployment, exact input schema binding and calibration fit remain unverified.

C.finding: Global grouped masks disclose exact selected encoded raw values; coalition receives their union. With deterministic heads and public masks, head outputs add no ideal-reader person-specific information beyond that raw union. The relationship exclusion is explicitly pre-fit and must face a common-removal control. The additive leave-one-atom-out scorecard is a heuristic and can miss interactions.
C.claim_limit: A favourable grouped mask may be useful without algorithmic or joint novelty.

D.finding: The revised pre-fit spec acknowledges the fixed-ID/near-collapsed-centroid counterexample and targets exact local hard-ID frequency differences plus a fixed pair-ID sign sketch, using hard-forward/soft-backward assignment. This removes the earlier decoded-centroid MMD/wire mismatch at the specified objective level. The pair sketch has a large nullspace and supplies no pair privacy certificate. Hard-ID churn and categorical local/pair attacks remain decisive.
D.implementation_status_at_audit: Static source inspection found surrogate_select returns hard-forward one-hot IDs with soft-distance gradients, and mmd_terms uses local one-hot frequency differences and paired sign-sketch features. This matches the revised premise at the inspected functions. The uncommitted trainer was still changing during audit, so no immutable implementation hash or whole-trainer approval is claimed. No assignment-change, gradient, endpoint, or deployment test was independently executed while S3's queue is closed.
D.control_gap: A realized-distortion-matched pooled compression control is not yet specified or charged. Equal code count/reconstruction coefficient alone does not establish component or joint attribution.
